attract.line2: Every guard's schedule is already known.
attract.line3: Would you like to try it yourself first?
intro1.title: THE PLAN
intro1.body: You are the thief. Get inside the Royal Mint, reach the vault, and start the presses.
intro1.controls: Move with the arrows or the stick. Click the floor to walk there.
intro1.tip: Guards see in cones. Stay out of them.
round1.result.fail: TIME UP — you never reached the vault
intro2.title: NOW YOU DEFEND
intro2.body: Same building. You are the chief of security. Move guards, lock doors, hit the alarm.
intro2.controls: Click a guard, then click where to send them. Click a door to lock it.
intro2.tip: You have three locks and one alarm.
round2.resultB.title: IT IS OVER
results.title: THE GAP
results.youTime: found in {t}, one at a time
results.aiNoSleep: It does not get tired. It does not sleep. It never stops trying.
results.footer: The attacker only needs one way in. You have to close all of them.
analogy.front: The front door is a convincing email that asks you to sign in.
analogy.side: The side door is the old system nobody remembers is still switched on.
analogy.dock: The loading bay is the supplier who is allowed into your network.
analogy.vent: The roof vent is the update you did not install.
analogy.sewer: The sewer is the password that leaked years ago and still works.
analogy.vaultDoor: The vault door is the one control you were sure would hold.
analogy.vault: The vault is your phone, your photos, your money.
analogy.shift: The shift change is your IT team going home at six.
leaderboard.title: BEST POLICE CHIEFS

round2.hoverDrop: Click {guard} again to put them down
think.title: THE AI IS PLANNING

round1.power: You cut the power. The cameras are down.
analogy.uniform: The staff uniform is the phone call from 'IT support' that you believed.
analogy.power: The fuse box is the attacker switching off your logging before they start.
round2.hintA: He is following a plan. Move a guard into it.

round1.truckRiding: In the back of the truck. SPACE to get out while it is stopped.

guide.left: Explore the left side of the building
guide.right: Explore the right side of the building
guide.entry: Choose any way in — follow a yellow arrow
guide.garage: Pick the inner garage door to leave the loading bay
guide.fuse: Go to the fuse box and cut the live wires
guide.vault: Use the card to enter the vault
guide.wall: Go to the wall and hold SPACE to drill; release to cool
guide.load: Go to a printing press and press SPACE to take a load
guide.van: Carry the load to the van and press SPACE to deliver
